title: Diverse Perspectives, Divergent Models: Cross-Cultural Evaluation of Depression Detection on Twitter

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generalization and performance (F1 score and recall) of depression detection models trained on standard benchmarks when applied to cross-cultural Twitter data, specifically comparing outcomes between users in the Global North and the Global South.
Gathering a custom geo-located Twitter dataset and analyzing country-level model performance disparities across seven different nations (US, UK, Australia, India, Nigeria, Philippines, South Africa).

Conducting a qualitative error analysis to identify how distinct linguistic features, word distributions, and code-mixing (using multiple languages) in non-Western countries negatively impact model accuracy.
